environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service but deployed in the 'prod-pci' VPC segment. CryptoProvider is instantiated via PKCS#11 interface to a Thales Luna Network HSM 7 (firmware 7.8.2) partition with policy OTT (Object Token Type) set to 'session-only' and mechanism restriction CKM_AES_CBC applied at the partition level. The HSM partition policy attribute 'Partition Policy Template 22: Allow Symmetric Decrypt Without Mechanism Enforcement' is set to 0 (disabled), meaning the HSM firmware itself performs PKCS#7 unpadding internally and returns only the unpadded plaintext via C_Decrypt. The application-layer validatePkcs7Padding() check therefore operates on already-unpadded data where the 'padding bytes' are actually payload content — the HSM has already stripped real padding and would have returned CKR_ENCRYPTED_DATA_INVALID (0x00000064) to the PKCS#11 layer before any bytes reach the application if padding was malformed. SQS queue additionally has a resource policy condition restricting aws:SourceVpce to vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f (the prod-pci interface endpoint).

config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Java 17, corretto, prod-pci VPC
config.hsm_partition_policy: Template 22 disabled, mechanism CKM_AES_CBC_PAD enforced at partition level
config.hsm_error_behavior: CKR_ENCRYPTED_DATA_INVALID returned on bad padding, no plaintext emitted
config.sqs_access: Restricted to VPC endpoint vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f via aws:SourceVpce condition
config.logging: CloudWatch Logs, WARN level only, 90-day retention
